_comment: Feature 006 — the committed source of the in-app client changelog. Ingested at agent boot and via POST /admin/content/reingest. Each entry upserts by `slug` (idempotent); entries the seed no longer lists are PRUNED on ingest — seed-owned rows only, including pre-slug legacy rows — so a reset leaves exactly this file. An operator's live Admin -> Updates edit wins and is preserved; an unreadable/empty file never prunes. Client-facing register: keep it tester-friendly, no dev detail.

entries.title: Sparky's knowledge updates ride out busy moments
entries.body: When the AI provider briefly rate-limits, the system that keeps Sparky's product knowledge up to date now waits and retries a few times instead of skipping that update. Nothing changes in how you use the app — answers just stay grounded in the latest docs more reliably.

entries.title: Sparky runs on a new model lineup — and reads your product docs more sharply
entries.body: Sparky's chat now runs on a newer generation of models on both the Beta and the Alpha: quicker free models for everyday questions and a stronger premium model for deeper ones. Its knowledge search also moved to a new embedding system, and we re-indexed everything it reads — the product docs, the changelog, and the tips — so answers about how SparkPoint works stay grounded in the current text. The daily research Sparky does on its own (checking vaults and writing its findings) now runs on the premium model too, on both environments. Nothing about your wallet, your keys, or how you sign changed.
